description: This file extends and customizes stock move and stock picking models in Odoo, adding links to purchase orders and handling invoice-related data.

classes.name: stock_move
classes.description: Extends stock.move to include a link to purchase order line.

classes.name: stock_picking
classes.description: Extends stock.picking to include a link to purchase order and methods for invoice processing.

methods.name: get_currency_id
methods.description: Retrieves the currency ID associated with the purchase order linked to the picking.

methods.name: _get_comment_invoice
methods.description: Generates invoice comments combining picking notes and purchase order notes.

methods.name: _get_price_unit_invoice
methods.description: Returns the unit price for invoice lines based on purchase order line.

methods.name: _get_discount_invoice
methods.description: Returns discount for invoice lines, defaulting to 0.0 if linked to purchase line.

methods.name: _get_taxes_invoice
methods.description: Returns applicable taxes for invoice lines based on purchase order line.

methods.name: _get_account_analytic_invoice
methods.description: Returns analytic account ID from purchase order line.

methods.name: _invoice_line_hook
methods.description: Hook for additional processing when creating invoice lines.

methods.name: _invoice_hook
methods.description: Associates invoice with purchase order when invoicing a picking.
